title: Scaffolding Dry Friction from Elementary Slip to Multi-Body Stacks
physical_system: Multi-body contact system governed by Coulomb-Amontons dry friction

rungs.physical_delta: Single body on a rough horizontal surface under external pulling force
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Linear inequality evaluation f_s <= mu_s N
rungs.transfer_requirement: Enforcing normal reaction balance N = mg and static friction bound

rungs.physical_delta: Particle crawling on rough curved hemispherical surface under varying inclination
rungs.transfer_requirement: Resolving local tangent and normal reaction components on curved boundary

rungs.physical_delta: Block sliding on movable wedge resting on frictionless floor
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Coupled 2-DOF dynamic equations with geometric non-penetration constraint
rungs.transfer_requirement: Coordinate transformation into non-inertial frame of the wedge with pseudo-force

rungs.physical_delta: Two-body stacked system with friction between blocks and driving force on bottom block
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Bifurcation between unified acceleration a_common and differential sliding accelerations
rungs.transfer_requirement: Identifying upper block maximum contact friction as the sole physical drive

pedagogical_objective: Systematically progress force analysis from single-body static thresholds to curved surface equilibria, coupled wedge constraints, and multi-body stacked friction bifurcations.
